Dead bodies on the beds across from you, everyone in the cabin you were in was slaughtered overnight. But by what? Before you can think you hear a noise approaching the cabin, you pick up your handgun and scout out the area… Features: bo1 perks bo2 powerup shaders bo2 perk shaders custom title screen music bo1 quick revive Credits: Treminaor UGX-Mods GAM3VIDZ
